cells.name: Great crucible
cells.description: The mega forge's head: a colossal tilting crucible on its working platform, its control core housed on its west flank and its spout pouring east onto the line.

cells.name: Great crucible melt
cells.description: Overlay: the great crucible's melt and its spout's run, drawn over its body so the engine can pulse it.

cells.name: Furnace control core
cells.description: The great crucible's control core, cut free and lying on its transport skid: the prize.

cells.name: Tapping furnace
cells.description: The pour line's tapping furnace: a domed refractory roof ringed by charging ports, its taphole and spout trough running south toward the crane bay.

cells.name: Tapping furnace melt
cells.description: Overlay: the melt in the tapping furnace's taphole and spout trough, so the engine can pulse it.

cells.name: Cooling stack
cells.description: An automated cooling stack: heavy shelf beams with its stacker carriage parked on the rail along its west side, empty.

cells.name: Cooling stack with castings
cells.description: The cooling stack with castings left in field cradles on four of its shelves when the work stopped.

cells.name: Pour head
cells.description: The line's pour head module: an armoured nozzle unit on four clamps. A b3 haul.

cells.name: Mould master
cells.description: The line's mould master module: a precision block with four master pattern faces. A b3 haul.

cells.name: Fallen runway beam
cells.description: A gantry runway beam fallen across the bay floor under its runway, its east end sheared with torn cables: the hall's best cover.

cells.name: Pallet bay marking
cells.description: Worn bay markings for dispatch: four corner brackets and a bay label bar, the rest transparent. Lay side by side for a row of bays.

cells.name: Trench cover
cells.description: Chequer-plate covers over a service trench between steel kerbs. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

cells.name: Drain gutter
cells.description: A slotted drain channel in floor plate. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

cells.name: Floor drain
cells.description: A square floor drain grate in its frame.

cells.name: Gantry runway
cells.description: Overhead: a gantry runway box beam with a copper linear-drive stator strip, a column cap at its middle. Drawn above units. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly every 4 cells.

cells.name: Cable tray
cells.description: Overhead: a ladder cable tray with its cables. Drawn above units. A run north-south; repeats seamlessly.

cells.name: Fallen cable tray
cells.description: A cable tray fallen to the floor, bent, its cables spilled.

cells.name: Oil stain
cells.description: An old dark oil stain on the floor. Overlay, laid along the traffic.

cells.name: Oil trail
cells.description: A trail of oil drips and smears along a traffic lane, north-south.

cells.name: Coolant stain
cells.description: A dried coolant spill, crusted pale blue-green.

cells.name: Scorch mark
cells.description: A heat scorch on the floor, sooty with a burnt-steel fringe.

cells.name: Arc burn
cells.description: An electrical arc burn: a blast star with forked burn lines, for a blown cabinet.

cells.name: Line pulpit
cells.description: The line's control pulpit seen from above: its armoured roof, visor strip along its south edge. Where b2 wakes the line.

cells.name: Recorder console
cells.description: A line recorder console: dead screen at its north end, a data-core socket, an amber status bar. b2's recorder.

cells.name: Mag-rail
cells.description: The feed mag-rail sunk flush in floor plate: a ribbed trough between guide rails, copper coil rings across it. A run: lay copies end to end north-south (rotate for east-west); it repeats seamlessly. Also the slag skid's lane.

cells.name: Mag-rail curve
cells.description: The mag-rail turning a quarter circle, meeting a straight rail at its south and east edges.

cells.name: Mag-rail end
cells.description: The end of a mag-rail: a decelerator coil block at its north end, the rail running out of its south edge.

cells.name: Feed capsule pod
cells.description: A sealed feed capsule pod riding the mag-rail, its nose a dim charge window: the furnace's charge.

cells.name: Derailed feed pod
cells.description: The feed capsule thrown off its rail askew, a band split, ore spilled.

cells.name: Hover slag skid
cells.description: A hover slag skid on four lift-fan rings, a slag pot on its spine.

cells.name: Slag skid glow
cells.description: Overlay: the glowing crack in the slag skid's crust.

cells.name: Crashed slag skid
cells.description: The slag skid crashed at the slag pit's lip, a fan ring torn off, its pot tipped east. Lay it with its east edge on the pit's edge.

cells.name: Slag skid spill
cells.description: Overlay: the slag running out of the tipped pot to its east edge, into the pit.

cells.name: Thrust wash
cells.description: Faint scorch streaks from hover skids' lift fans, north-south, laid along their lanes.

cells.name: Ladle in its manipulator
cells.description: A pouring ladle in the clamp yoke of an overhead manipulator, full of melt. Overhead: drawn above units.

cells.name: Ladle melt
cells.description: Overlay: the ladle's melt.

cells.name: Ladle tipped mid-pour
cells.description: The manipulator holding the ladle tipped mid-pour, its bowl near empty. Overhead: drawn above units.

cells.name: Ladle pour
cells.description: Overlay: the melt pouring from the tipped ladle's lip.

cells.name: Finishing cell
cells.description: A robotic finishing cell: a robot arm on its turret plinth reaching to a clamped casting.

cells.name: Metrology bed
cells.description: A metrology bed with its scanning arch across it.
